name: Sign in with LinkedIn
plain: A login where LinkedIn confirms the person and shares basic professional profile details.
meaning: With scopes openid, profile and email the site gets sub, name, given_name, family_name, picture, locale, email and email_verified in an ID token. Work history and connections need separate approved partner APIs.

web.api: OIDC authorization code flow at linkedin.com/oauth/v2/authorization

access.persistence: Access tokens last about 60 days; refresh tokens up to 1 year for approved apps (verify)
access.revocation: Clear site data, browser privacy settings

limits.headline: Can sign you in with LinkedIn and see your basic profile details
limits.user_action: You tap Sign in with LinkedIn and approve the permissions listed on the LinkedIn screen
can: Receive a stable LinkedIn ID for you
Get your name, profile photo, language and email
Learn whether your email is verified
cannot: See your work history, connections or messages; that needs separate approved partner access
Prove who you are in real life
Get anything beyond the permissions listed on the approval screen

story.what_it_is: A login where LinkedIn confirms who you are and shares basic work profile details.
story.for_you: You click the LinkedIn button, review a screen listing what the site will get (name, photo, email) and agree. The site now knows your professional identity, not your LinkedIn password.
story.for_makers: Makers of work and hiring tools get a real name and a verified work flavored profile. This builds trust and gives sales and recruiting teams cleaner leads.

use_cases.example: A job board or recruiting web app lets a candidate sign in with LinkedIn and fills in name, photo and email.
A B2B software trial form accepts LinkedIn sign in so the sales team gets a real name and work email.
An online course site uses LinkedIn sign in so a learner can share a finished certificate to their profile.
A networking or events app imports a person's name and photo so introductions look familiar.
Marketers use the verified work email for lead matching in ad and B2B campaigns.
A site trusts that a LinkedIn signed token is harder to fake in bulk than a plain email sign up.

risks: Profile details tied to your real name

technical_bounds: Only basic profile via Sign in with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect
Positions and connections need partner program

abuse: Identity linking to a professional profile

linkedin.how: LinkedIn is the identity provider; its tracking stack can match the signed in member to Insight Tag visits.

history.change: LinkedIn moved Sign in to OpenID Connect

refs.label: LinkedIn Sign In with OpenID Connect
